datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Mali to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data for each classification phase was compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for each month of 2021, representing projected food insecurity scenarios at the sub-national level.
